module: Node "StartScreen Text Panel" (repeat_instant, color ui). Adds a text panel with a header to the start screen. Inputs: flow, header and text (string or table), experimental (hidden, obsolete), flavour (hidden; default, experimental or info). Output: flow (chainFlow).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

postInit.desc: Defines the enforced templates of the flavour pin: default, experimental, info.

work.desc: Copies flow; if text is non-empty, adds a textPanel. If the header is "missions.missions.general.rules" or "Rules", the panel goes on the rules page instead of main. experimental=true forces the "experimental" flavour.
